reason: Confirmation Pilot #18 exposed the generic Marking Pack reliability weakness that triggered Reliability v2 complete-diagnostic validation and provider-free requalification. The subsequent Reliability v2 Q7 live-worker soak run 33265434110 on approved main 69d7abb7d3236616b687cbed480e7584ceb69fc9 exposed a new generic Assessment Item provider-contract class: seven of ten live Assessment Item samples omitted required subquestion-level maxMark, requirementIds and/or coverageEvidence before the targeted-repair boundary could run. The Assessment Item candidate boundary now preserves model ownership of those educational fields while allowing omissions to reach complete deterministic diagnostics and the existing single bounded repair. Q1-Q6 have been requalified provider-free against that corrected boundary; Q7 remains pending, the full-course pilot remains paused and Q8 is not eligible.
